detailed_descriptions.en: Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions. Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren't always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method. 1) Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM… 2) Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA! 3) Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE! You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done? Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened. It did. It was Dan! Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt and Snapshot Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook. Funny, colourful and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast and moving on to the next job. Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy. Key Features Outrageous tools. Sensible intentions Use a sniper rifle to fix everyday problems. No danger. No drama. Just long-range problem solving. A hidden object game through a sniper scope Scan busy 3D scenes, spot what’s wrong and solve it with one perfectly aimed shot. Over 160 jobs across six lively locations Take on everyday jobs, Answerphone requests, emergency jobs, boss jobs and special challenges, plus bonus games and three dedicated minigames: Bowling, Tennis and Air Hockey . Every job is a tiny mystery Figure out cryptic clues, search the scene and work out what actually needs fixing, with dynamic solutions that mean jobs can change each time you play. A playful 3D world full of shareable moments Explore six packed locations with 100+ secrets, 200+ ambient stories and 45 hilarious photo opportunities waiting to be discovered and shared. Grow your business one job at a time Earn money and reputation from successful jobs, upgrade and customise your rifle, unlock costumes and collectibles, decorate your office hub and expand your operation. Unexpected problems. Serious precision. Zero violence Fix signs, tighten bolts, pop balloons and jump-start fireworks. Nobody gets hurt. Ever.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren't always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

1) Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…

2) Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!

3) Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done?

Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened.

It did. It was Dan!

            

Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt and Snapshot Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook.

Funny, colourful and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.

Key Features

  • Outrageous tools. Sensible intentions
    Use a sniper rifle to fix everyday problems. No danger. No drama. Just long-range problem solving.

  • A hidden object game through a sniper scope
    Scan busy 3D scenes, spot what’s wrong and solve it with one perfectly aimed shot.

  • Over 160 jobs across six lively locations
    Take on everyday jobs, Answerphone requests, emergency jobs, boss jobs and special challenges, plus bonus games and three dedicated minigames: Bowling, Tennis and Air Hockey.

  • Every job is a tiny mystery
    Figure out cryptic clues, search the scene and work out what actually needs fixing, with dynamic solutions that mean jobs can change each time you play.

  • A playful 3D world full of shareable moments
    Explore six packed locations with 100+ secrets, 200+ ambient stories and 45 hilarious photo opportunities waiting to be discovered and shared.

  • Grow your business one job at a time
    Earn money and reputation from successful jobs, upgrade and customise your rifle, unlock costumes and collectibles, decorate your office hub and expand your operation.

  • Unexpected problems. Serious precision. Zero violence
    Fix signs, tighten bolts, pop balloons and jump-start fireworks. Nobody gets hurt. Ever.
